units.source_text: 她想：“我从这世上消失已有一年了，但恐还有人在思念我吧。”

en.t: She thought, "It has already been a year since I vanished from this world, but perhaps there are still people who remember me."

units.source_text: 如此回忆往昔之时亦多。

en.t: There were many times when she looked back on the past in this way.

units.source_text: 有一天，有一个人用一只寻常的篮盛了些新出的嫩菜，送来给妹尼僧。

en.t: One day, someone placed some freshly sprouted young greens in an ordinary basket and brought them to the younger nun.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧以此转赠浮舟，附一诗曰：

en.t: The younger nun passed them on as a gift to Ukifune, adding a poem that read:
